aerialScenarioDesc: For aerial datasets where overlapping sub-images form the same scene. This enables later grouping, stitching alignment, and global/tile annotation mapping.
aerialNamingExample: Recommended name: buildingA_3x4_r01_c01.jpg. Prefix + MxN + row-major sequence is also supported later.
aerialDetailDesc: This dataset keeps aerial sub-images and stitching configuration. Upload still stores files normally; later preprocessing can build scene relations from name prefixes, M*N grids, and overlap ratios.
dropUpload: Drop files or click to upload
